## Purpose
The planning report for one run: start and end, the time per layer, each question asked and how long it waited, the model and tool calls, rewinds and errors.

## Responsibilities
- `PlanningReport({runId})` reads `runsApi.report`, refreshed while the run is live.
- Parts: `Stat`, `Section`, `TimeChart` / `ChartRow` and `LayerTable`.

## Key elements
`PlanningReport`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Backend `/api/runs/{id}/report` (`app/runs/report.build_report`). Used by the planner and the Orchestrator.
